chapter: Records, dances and Blanche Calloway (repeated passages)
title: Fans who listened as well as danced
summary: There were fans in the late 1920s who invited musicians home and listened as well as danced.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: Were there people then in the U.S.A. in the late '20s who were what you might call fans of the
-- of the musicians, and who would come by to maybe invite you to their house and stuff?
Sure there would be -- yeah, sure.
So they were listening to the music as well as dancing to it.
Yes. Uh-huh. They'd dance and listen.
